The Conference of the Birds by Farid ud-Din Attar

白鸟朝凤

“Escape your self-hood’s vicious tyranny –
Whoever can evade the Self transcends
This world and as a lover he ascends.”

“Turn to what truly lives, reject what seems.”

“Take refuge in the orders of your guide,
And like a slave subdue your restive pride.”

“The lovely forms and colours are undone,
And what seemed many things is only one.
All things are one – there isn’t any two;
It isn’t me who speaks; it isn’t you.”

“I am a mirror set before your eyes,
And all who come before my splendour see
Themselves, their own unique reality;”

“Now know that all you trusted was untrue.”

“Be nothing first! and then you will exist,
You cannot live whilst life and Self persist –
Till you reach Nothingness you cannot see
The Life you long for in eternity.”
